Definition: from G3623; administration (of a household or estate); specially, a (religious) "economy":--dispensation, stewardship.
BiblicalUsage: Oikonomia is stewardship, the administration of a household, and by extension the ordering of God's plan. It is the steward's account in Luke 16:2, the dispensation of the gospel committed to Paul in 1 Corinthians 9:17, and the dispensation of the fullness of times in Ephesians 1:10, when God gathers all things in Christ. Colossians 1:25 calls it the dispensation of God given to Paul to fulfil the word of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe stewardship is the shape of the Christian life: nothing we hold is ours, and everything is administered for the Lord of the house. That is why I hold that God's plan has an order to it, a dispensation, and the steward's joy is to see it carried out.
